description.short: Teams agent UX demo — slash, targeted msgs, citations, streaming.
description.full: Relecloud is a Teams agent prototype showcasing the modern Teams SDK UX investments end-to-end: slash commands and targeted messages in group chats, with AI-generated label, citations, feedback, and a promote-to-chat action; plus streaming, citations, and suggested follow-ups in 1:1 conversations. All data is mocked — this is a demo agent for showcasing UX, not a production travel assistant.
